claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Holyhead off Holyhead (5th inst.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Edinburgh (Br.), Halcrow, Liverpool, Sept. 5, Queens-
town 6th, with mdse. and 432[?] pass. to John G. Dale. 5th inst., off
Holyhead, signalized steamship City of London bound in; 6th, off
Minehead, passed a National Company's steamship bound in; 7th, 23
miles E of Fastnet, signalized a Cunard steamship supposed to be the
Cuba, bound in; same day, 28 miles W of Fastnet, steamship City of
Dublin bound in; 16th[?], 5 miles W of Cape Race, saw the hull of a
large Hamburg vessel on shore and the crew apparently living in a
tent; 20th, 139 miles W of Sandy Hook, signalized American ship
Ellen Austin, bound W.
